sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: To say when something happens, add *-n* to the day. After a consonant the ending is *-on*, *-en* or *-ön*, chosen by vowel harmony: *-on* after a back vowel (*szombaton*), *-en* after *e* (*kedden*, *pénteken*), *-ön* after *ö* (*csütörtökön*). After a vowel only *-n* is added: *hétfőn*, and *szerda* becomes *szerdán* (the final *a* lengthens to *á*). *Vasárnap* takes no ending. Ask with *Mikor?*

items.english: When do you all study? – On Tuesday.
We cook not on Monday but on Wednesday.

sections.content: In *szerdán* the final *-a* of *szerda* lengthens to *-á* and nothing else is added. In *kedden* and *pénteken* the *e* belongs to the ending *-en*; it is not an extra vowel.
